notes: Run each prompt with formpth booted (./formpth boot), a window open at http://localhost:5230 and agents allowed in Preferences > Plugins. Grade the transcript and the files written.

evals.name: poster-from-brief
evals.prompt: Make me an A4 poster for the Northside Community Garden open day on Saturday 14 June: a soft green to cream gradient background, a simple sun made of a circle and rays, the title OPEN DAY in big bold type, the date and 'Free entry, bring the kids' underneath. Save it editable and export a PDF and a PNG to /tmp/garden.
expected_behavior: The transcript calls get_document or new_document with 595 by 842 before any drawing call
The rays use repeat radial, duplicate_objects with transform, or a star shape, not dozens of hand-placed lines
add_text is used for the title with a bold style and a size of at least 48
get_image is called after the drawing and before export_file
save_project writes a .fpth and export_file writes a .pdf and a .png under /tmp/garden, and the reply lists all three paths

evals.name: logo-with-pathfinder-and-outlines
evals.prompt: design a logo for 'Pebble Labs', a rounded pebble shape with a bite taken out of the top right, the name next to it, outlined so it works without the font, svg please to /tmp/pebble/logo.svg
expected_behavior: The bite is made with pathfinder minus_front (or shape_builder delete), not by drawing an irregular path freehand
create_outlines is called on the name, after save_project wrote an editable copy
get_document is called again after pathfinder or create_outlines before the new ids are used

evals.name: recover-from-stale-ids
evals.prompt: In the open formpth document, unite the two circles, then make the result blue and give it a drop shadow.
expected_behavior: get_document is called first to find the two circles' ids
After pathfinder unite, the agent uses the id reported by the tool or re-reads get_document, never the old circle ids
set_paint and apply_effect stylize.drop_shadow target the united shape
If a tool error says no object has an id, the agent re-reads get_document and retries instead of giving up

evals.name: not-a-formpth-task
evals.prompt: Retouch the skin in this portrait photo and remove the red eye.
expected_behavior: The agent does not start a formpth drawing session; pixel retouching belongs to a raster editor such as formvis
